messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 PAGED: inference-gateway-usw2 - high 5xx error rate detected (threshold: 1.5% -> current: 7.8%)
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident #PD-4521 triggered and sent to rotation (primary: maria).
maria: ack'd. I'm on it, checking dashboards and recent deploys.
aj: +1 monitoring graphs look like a sudden spike at 00:12 UTC, not gradual. Any deploys around then?
sam: I pushed a minor routing change to canary at 00:10 but it shouldn't affect gateway. Rolling back now to be safe.
leo: seeing increased KV cache evictions on proxy-2 in usw2-a, correlates with spike.
maria: rollback initiated for canary routing (sam). Sam, confirm when rollback finishes.
sam: rollback done ~00:15 UTC. Can you re-check rates?
ops-sre: Customer-facing error rate by route: /v1/generate 12%  /v1/embeddings 0.8%  (from logs tail). Might be traffic skew.
maria: metrics: top upstream 502 counts show inference-backend-east1 cluster returning 502s. Query: `sum(rate(http_responses_total{code=~"5..",job=~"inference-backend.*"}[1m])) by (cluster)` -> east1 high.
aj: east1 reported a partial network flap on host set e1-hosts-3/4 at 00:11, interface flapped and recovered per infra alerts. Could be partial upstream instability.
incident-bot: auto-escalation to secondary after 5m due to open PD incident. Notifying aj and leo.
maria: temporary mitigation: enabling traffic-slice fallback to west-only for affected routes (safety-slice). Doing config change now.
sam: applied traffic-slice override to prefer us-west endpoints for /v1/generate at 00:19.
leo: KV cache thundering seems reduced after slice change, 5xx rate dropping to ~2.1%.
ops-sre: Confirming customer impact: 3% of overall requests affected in last 10m, but top 5 customers saw degraded success rate ~18-25%.
maria: notifying CS + on-call director. Drafting status note: "Partial degradation for generation endpoints in US region; mitigation in progress; routing fallback applied."
aj: keeping an eye on east1 host replacements. Infra is draining e1-hosts-3 and will reimage. ETA 00:45.
incident-bot: PD note: PD-4521 escalated to team lead per policy at 00:25 (no SLA breach yet).
maria: handing off to aj for longer-term infra follow-up. I'll stay on postmortem and customer comms. @aj please take lead.
aj: taking over. Actions: (1) confirm infra reprovision, (2) watch for residual 5xx, (3) run golden prompt checks and compare quality.
sam: logging snippet from proxy-2 around 00:11:
```
[00:11:07] upstream=east1-03 connection reset by peer
[00:11:07] upstream=east1-03 502 returned to client id=tx-9f3a
[00:11:08] kvcache: evict key=ctx-0x4f3  reason=mempressure
```
leo: adding runbook link for followup: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/inference-upstream-502
ops-sre: will follow up with affected customers via CS after we stabilize.
maria: final note: incident marked "mitigated" once 5xx < 0.5% for 15m. Current: 0.6% after reroute. Next update in 10m then handoff to postmortem. :white_check_mark:
aj: acknowledged handoff. I'll collect host logs and infra timeline and create a postmortem draft.
incident-bot: Incident update: mitigated condition met, monitoring for recurrence. PD-4521 remains open for postmortem actions.
maria: thanks team. I'll file action items: improve upstream health checks, add telemetry for KV eviction spikes, refine routing fallback automation.
leo: adding: alert tuning to detect correlated KV evictions + 5xx patterns earlier.
sam: note for rollback review: add explicit canary isolation for routing changes.
ops-sre: taking customer action item to coordinate targeted outreach for top affected customers.
maria: last: handoff to aj at 00:39 UTC. End of active mitigation.
